chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: It was narrated to me by al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Aqooli from Ahmad ibn Harun al-Attar from Ziyad al-Abdi from Musa ibn Ja'far from his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father Muhammad ibn Ali from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn from his father al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) who said:

When Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, created Musa ibn Imran, He spoke to him on Mount Sinai. Then He looked upon the earth with a glance, and created the cornelian (Aqiq) from the light of His Face. Then He said: 'I have sworn by Myself that I will not punish with the Fire the hand that wears it, when one is devoted to Ali (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.آلَیْتُ بِنَفْسِی: I swore by Myself, a formula of divine oath
key_terms.الْعَقِیق: Cornelian stone, a semi-precious gemstone often worn as a ring in Islamic tradition
key_terms.تَوَلَّی عَلِیّاً: Devoted to Ali, showing love and allegiance to Imam Ali
key_terms.طُورُ سِینَا: Mount Sinai, where Allah spoke to Prophet Musa
key_terms.نُورُ وَجْهِهِ: The light of His Face, referring to divine light or attribute
key_terms.کَفَّ لَابِسِهِ: The hand that wears it, referring to the wearer of the ring

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for wearing a cornelian ring and being devoted to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal* establishes a unique cosmological origin for the cornelian stone (Aqiq), linking it directly to the divine light revealed during Musa’s encounter on Mount Sinai. It further connects this physical object to spiritual intercession, promising protection from Hellfire for those who wear it while maintaining devotion (tawalli) to Imam Ali, thereby blending material symbolism with eschatological reward in Shia devotional practice.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 10. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by al-Hassan b. Ali al-Aqooli from Ahmad b. Harun al-’Attar from Ziyad al-’Abdi from Musa b. Ja’far from his father Ja’far b. Muhammad from his father Muhammad b. Ali from his father Ali b. al-Hussain from his father al-Hussain b. Ali (a.s.) who said:
‘I swear by Myself, I have made it obligatory on Myself that I will never punish with fire (of Hell) one who wears cornelian in his hand and is the lover of Ali (a.s.).”
